description.value: The Waverley Liquor Store is a cold beer and wine shop attached to The Waverley Hotel in Cumberland, BC, a town celebrated as one of Canada's premier mountain biking destinations. Despite its compact size, the store carries a broad selection that emphasises local BC wines and regional craft beers. It sits within a larger hospitality complex — the same building houses a pub, a kitchen, and hotel rooms — making it a natural post-ride stop.
